<function name="GetHeaderHeight" parent="DListView" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Returns the height of the header of the <page>DListView</page>.

See also <page>DListView:SetHeaderHeight</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The height of the header of the <page>DListView</page>.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
